summary_en: A practical guide to Xi'an: when to go, how to get there and get around, where to stay, the sights not to miss, a four-day itinerary and some tips.

sentences.zh: 如果你正在计划去中国旅行，那么西安应该出现在你的计划里。
sentences.en: If you're planning a trip to China, Xi'an should be part of your plan.

sentences.zh: 西安是陕西省的省会，也是中国最古老的城市之一。
sentences.en: Xi'an is the capital of Shaanxi Province, and one of the oldest cities in China.

sentences.zh: 历史上，一共有十三个朝代在这里建都，所以人们也叫它“十三朝古都”。
sentences.en: Over its history, thirteen dynasties made their capital here, so people also call it "the ancient capital of thirteen dynasties".

sentences.zh: 不管你喜欢历史、美食，还是只想拍一些好看的照片，西安都不会让你失望。
sentences.en: Whether you love history or food, or just want to take some nice photos, Xi'an won't disappoint you.

sentences.zh: 什么时候去最合适？
sentences.en: When is the best time to go?

sentences.zh: 西安的每个季节都各有各的味道。
sentences.en: Each season in Xi'an has its own flavour.

sentences.zh: 春天从三月到五月，秋天从九月到十一月，这两个季节不冷不热，最适合出门和拍照。
sentences.en: Spring runs from March to May and autumn from September to November; these two seasons are neither cold nor hot, perfect for going out and taking photos.

sentences.zh: 夏天虽然比较热，但是游客最多，活动也最丰富。
sentences.en: Summer is fairly hot, but it has the most visitors and the most going on.

sentences.zh: 冬天游客少，适合想安安静静地感受古城的人。
sentences.en: Winter has fewer visitors, which suits anyone who wants to experience the old city in peace and quiet.

sentences.zh: 怎么去西安？
sentences.en: How do you get to Xi'an?

sentences.zh: 西安的交通很方便。
sentences.en: Getting around Xi'an is easy.

sentences.zh: 你可以坐飞机到西安机场，再换地铁或者机场大巴进入市区。
sentences.en: You can fly into Xi'an airport and then take the metro or the airport coach into the city.

sentences.zh: 也可以坐高铁或者火车来，西安站就在市中心。
sentences.en: You can also come by high-speed or ordinary train; Xi'an Station is right in the city centre.

sentences.zh: 在城里，坐地铁差不多能到大部分地方。
sentences.en: Within the city, the metro can take you to almost all the places you'll want to see.

sentences.zh: 你可以在微信里打开乘车码，用手机直接上车。
sentences.en: You can open a transit QR code in WeChat and board straight away with your phone.

sentences.zh: 不过，兵马俑离地铁站比较远，打车过去更节省时间。
sentences.en: But the Terracotta Warriors are quite far from a metro station, so a taxi saves time.

sentences.zh: 住在哪里最方便？
sentences.en: Where is the most convenient place to stay?

sentences.zh: 住在钟楼、大雁塔、南门这些地铁站附近，坐车和吃饭都很方便。
sentences.en: Stay near metro stations like Bell Tower, Big Wild Goose Pagoda or South Gate, and getting around and eating out are both easy.

sentences.zh: 你可以根据自己想花多少钱选择酒店。
sentences.en: Choose a hotel according to how much you want to spend.

sentences.zh: 说到西安，很多人第一个想到的就是兵马俑。
sentences.en: When it comes to Xi'an, the first thing many people think of is the Terracotta Warriors.

sentences.zh: 它们被称为“世界第八大奇迹”。
sentences.en: They are called "the eighth wonder of the world".

sentences.zh: 一九七四年，一位农民在打井的时候，偶然发现了它们。
sentences.en: In 1974, a farmer digging a well discovered them by chance.

sentences.zh: 后来，考古学家又找到了三个很大的坑，里面有上万个和真人一样大的士兵和马。
sentences.en: Later, archaeologists found three huge pits holding tens of thousands of life-size soldiers and horses.

sentences.zh: 而且每个士兵脸上的表情都不一样，让人印象非常深刻。
sentences.en: And every soldier's face has a different expression — it makes a very deep impression.

sentences.zh: 如果你去参观，最好提前在网上订票，再请一位导游，否则很难理解它们背后的故事。
sentences.en: If you visit, book tickets online in advance and hire a guide — otherwise the stories behind them are hard to understand.

sentences.zh: 西安城墙也是一个必去的地方。
sentences.en: Xi'an's city wall is also a must-see.

sentences.zh: 这座城墙是明朝，也就是十四世纪，建成的。
sentences.en: The wall was built in the Ming dynasty, in other words the fourteenth century.

sentences.zh: 它是中国现在规模最大、保存得最完整的古代城墙。
sentences.en: It is the largest and most completely preserved ancient city wall in China today.

sentences.zh: 你可以登上去散步，租一辆自行车骑一圈，或者坐小车参观。
sentences.en: You can climb up and walk along it, rent a bike and ride a lap, or take a small cart around.

sentences.zh: 从上面往下看，古城里外的风景都能看得很清楚。
sentences.en: Looking down from the top, you can see the old city inside and outside the wall clearly.

sentences.zh: 白天和晚上，这里完全不一样，建议两个时间都去看看。
sentences.en: By day and by night it looks completely different, so it's worth going at both times.

sentences.zh: 大雁塔是西安的文化标志之一。
sentences.en: The Big Wild Goose Pagoda is one of Xi'an's cultural landmarks.

sentences.zh: 它是公元六五二年建成的，那时候还是唐朝。
sentences.en: It was built in AD 652, during the Tang dynasty.

sentences.zh: 玄奘从印度带回来的书，以前就放在这里。
sentences.en: The scriptures that Xuanzang brought back from India were once kept here.

sentences.zh: 它前面的广场很大，晚上有音乐喷泉表演，非常漂亮。
sentences.en: The square in front of it is huge, and in the evening there's a musical fountain show — it's beautiful.

sentences.zh: 离它不远还有小雁塔，游客更少，也更安静，适合慢慢散步。
sentences.en: Not far away is the Small Wild Goose Pagoda: fewer visitors, quieter, good for a slow stroll.

sentences.zh: 钟楼和鼓楼是两座明朝的建筑，位于西安的正中心。
sentences.en: The Bell Tower and Drum Tower are two Ming dynasty buildings in the very centre of Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 以前，人们早上敲钟、晚上打鼓，告诉大家时间；现在，它们成了西安最有名的建筑。
sentences.en: People once struck the bell in the morning and beat the drum in the evening to tell everyone the time; now they are Xi'an's most famous buildings.

sentences.zh: 天快黑的时候去最好，你可以一次看到白天、日落和亮灯以后三种景色。
sentences.en: Dusk is the best time to go: in one visit you'll see three different views — daylight, sunset and the lights coming on.

sentences.zh: 钟楼、鼓楼和回民街都离得很近，可以安排在一起。
sentences.en: The Bell Tower, Drum Tower and Muslim Quarter street are all close together, so you can see them in one trip.

sentences.zh: 回民街是西安最有名的小吃街，这里有很多小吃店。
sentences.en: The Muslim Quarter street is Xi'an's most famous snack street, full of snack shops.

sentences.zh: 肉夹馍、凉皮……每一种都值得你尝一尝。
sentences.en: Roujiamo, liangpi… every kind is worth a taste.

sentences.zh: 如果你对中国的历史、文化感兴趣，一定要去陕西历史博物馆。
sentences.en: If you're interested in Chinese history and culture, you must go to the Shaanxi History Museum.

sentences.zh: 在这里，你会更了解这座城市，也更了解这个国家。
sentences.en: Here you'll come to understand this city — and this country — better.

sentences.zh: 如果你是第一次来西安，可以安排四天三晚。
sentences.en: If it's your first time in Xi'an, you could plan four days and three nights.

sentences.zh: 第一天，去兵马俑和华清池，晚上看一场演出。
sentences.en: Day one: the Terracotta Warriors and Huaqing Pool, then a show in the evening.

sentences.zh: 第二天上午登上城墙，下午去钟楼和鼓楼，晚上在回民街吃晚饭。
sentences.en: Day two: climb the city wall in the morning, visit the Bell and Drum Towers in the afternoon, and have dinner on the Muslim Quarter street.

sentences.zh: 第三天，先去历史博物馆，再去大雁塔，晚上去大唐不夜城看灯光和表演。
sentences.en: Day three: the history museum first, then the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, and in the evening the lights and shows at Great Tang Everbright City.

sentences.zh: 第四天可以多睡一会儿，在城里逛一逛，然后准备离开。
sentences.en: Day four: sleep in, wander round the city, then get ready to leave.

sentences.zh: 暑假和国庆节的时候游客特别多，一定要提前订好酒店和门票。
sentences.en: The summer holidays and National Day are peak times, so be sure to book hotels and tickets early.

sentences.zh: 历史博物馆虽然是免费的，但是很难订，最好提前几天在网上订好。
sentences.en: The history museum is free, but it's very hard to get a booking, so book online a few days ahead.

sentences.zh: 夏天的西安很热，出门一定要注意防晒。
sentences.en: Xi'an is very hot in summer, so protect yourself from the sun when you go out.

sentences.zh: 去兵马俑的话，可以坐地铁九号线到“华清池”站，出站以后再打车过去，又方便又便宜。
sentences.en: For the Terracotta Warriors, take metro Line 9 to Huaqing Pool station and a taxi from there — convenient and cheap.

sentences.zh: 所有地方都要用身份证买票，外国游客记得带上护照。
sentences.en: Every site needs ID to buy a ticket; foreign visitors should remember to bring their passport.

sentences.zh: 晚上亮灯以后，在钟楼、鼓楼和南门拍照特别好看。
sentences.en: After the lights come on, photos from the Bell Tower, Drum Tower and South Gate look especially good.

sentences.zh: 大雁塔广场的音乐喷泉表演也一定要去看看。
sentences.en: Be sure to see the musical fountain show at the Big Wild Goose Pagoda too.

sentences.zh: 希望这篇介绍对你有帮助。
sentences.en: I hope this introduction is useful to you.

sentences.zh: 祝你在西安过得开心！
sentences.en: Have a great time in Xi'an!

grammar_points.pattern: 不管 A 还是 B，都……
grammar_points.explanation_en: "No matter whether A or B, …" — the result holds in every case. 都 in the second half is what ties it together.
grammar_points.example_zh: 不管下雨还是下雪，他都走路上班。
grammar_points.example_en: Whether it rains or snows, he walks to work.

grammar_points.pattern: 是 + time / place + verb + 的
grammar_points.explanation_en: Used to highlight when, where or how a past action happened, rather than the action itself.
grammar_points.example_zh: 这座桥是一九五八年修好的。

grammar_points.explanation_en: "…, otherwise …": the first part gives advice, the second says what happens if you ignore it. More formal than 不然.
grammar_points.example_zh: 出门要带伞，否则会被雨淋湿。
grammar_points.example_en: Take an umbrella, otherwise you'll get soaked.

questions.q_zh: 为什么人们叫西安“十三朝古都”？
questions.q_en: Why do people call Xi'an "the ancient capital of thirteen dynasties"?
questions.answer_en: Because thirteen dynasties made their capital there.

questions.q_zh: 兵马俑是怎么被发现的？
questions.q_en: How were the Terracotta Warriors discovered?
questions.answer_en: A farmer found them by chance while digging a well in 1974.

questions.q_zh: 文章说，去钟楼和鼓楼最好的时间是什么时候？为什么？
questions.q_en: According to the article, when is the best time to visit the Bell and Drum Towers, and why?
questions.answer_en: Around dusk, because you can see the daytime view, the sunset and the lights coming on in one visit.
